instruction: How do I implement Use CORSMiddleware in FastAPI? Provide a complete, modern working code example.
input: Reference documentation: tutorial/cors.md (CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) > Use CORSMiddleware)
output:
Here is how to implement Use CORSMiddleware in FastAPI according to the official documentation:

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

app = FastAPI()

origins = [
    "http://localhost.tiangolo.com",
    "https://localhost.tiangolo.com",
    "http://localhost:3000",
]

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=origins,
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)
```
